title: Prometheus
description: A clue to mankind's origins leads a team of explorers to deep space, where they must fight a terrifying battle to save the future of the human race.

title: Green Zone
description: An Army officer and his team of inspectors stumble upon an elaborate cover-up as they hunt for weapons of mass destruction in Iraq.

title: Red Riding Hood
description: A young woman (Amanda Seyfried) begins to suspect that the werewolf terrorizing her village is someone she loves.

title: The Wolfman
description: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.

title: Final Destination 5
description: When a man's premonition saves them from a fatal bridge collapse, several unfortunate souls learn that Death will not be cheated.

title: Pacific Rim Uprising
description: Jake Pentecost, son of Stacker Pentecost, reunites with Mako Mori to lead a new generation of Jaeger pilots, including rival Lambert and 15-year-old hacker Amara, against a new Kaiju threat.

title: Spring Breakers
description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

title: Joker
description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

title: The Shape of Water
description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

title: The Whistlers
description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

title: The Usual Suspects
description: A detective (Chazz Palminteri) questions a con man about his relationships with assorted criminals (Stephen Baldwin, Gabriel Byrne) and their link to a ship explosion.

title: Blood Simple
description: Complications arise when the owner of a Texas bar pays a man (M. Emmet Walsh) to kill his wife (Frances McDormand) and her lover (John Getz).

title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

title: The Lobster
description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice.

title: Cleaner
description: Radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

title: My Soul to Take
description: A teen (Max Thieriot) must figure a way to save his friends from a presumed-dead serial killer who has returned to finish the job he started 16 years earlier.

title: Hail Satan?
description: Lucien Greaves co-founds the Satanic Temple, a religious movement that calls for a revolution to save the nation's soul.

title: Disobedience
description: Photographer Ronit Krushka returns to the London community that shunned her decades earlier for her childhood attraction to a female friend. Their happy reunion soon reignites their burning passion as they explore boundaries of faith and sexuality.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
description: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek.

title: Hidden Figures
description: NASA mathematicians Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson cross gender and race lines to help launch astronaut John Glenn into outer space.

title: Love, Simon
description: Teenager Simon Spier hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.

title: Hall Pass
description: Rick and Fred, two husbands who are having difficulty in their marriages, are given a Hall Pass by their wives for one week, they can do whatever they want.

title: Atomic Blonde
description: With the Berlin Wall about to fall, an elite MI6 spy travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring.

title: Women Is Losers
description: Celina Guerrero attempts to rise above poverty in the 1960s San Francisco.

title: The Post
description: In 1971, publisher Katharine Graham and editor Ben Bradlee of The Washington Post risk their careers and very freedom to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: Queer
description: Lee, a solitary American in Mexico City, falls for a beautiful, elusive former soldier. Journeying together into the jungle, Lee sees, for the first time, the possibility of an intimate and infinite love.

title: The Possession
description: Parents (Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Kyra Sedgwick) must work together to save their young daughter (Natasha Calis) from a dybbuk, a malevolent spirit that inhabits and ultimately devours its human host.

title: A History of Violence
description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner.

title: Flashpoint
description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963.

title: Bring Her Back
description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
description: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home.

title: Time Bandits
description: Cosmic dwarfs take a boy on an odyssey featuring Robin Hood (John Cleese), Napoleon, King Agamemnon (Sean Connery).

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: Smoking Tigers
description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

title: The Art of Getting By
description: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).

title: Risky Business
description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

title: Opus
description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

title: Rain Man
description: A wheeler-dealer (Tom Cruise) meets his brother (Dustin Hoffman), an institutionalized autistic-savant, heir to $3 million.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: It's Complicated
description: A restaurateur (Meryl Streep) falls into an affair with her remarried ex-husband (Alec Baldwin), while an architect (Steve Martin) that she hired to refurbish her kitchen falls in love with her.

title: The Craft
description: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles.

title: Repo Men
description: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

title: Men
description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

title: Walkabout
description: A lost teenager (Jenny Agutter) and her little brother (Lucien John) meet an Aboriginal teen (David Gulpilil) in the Outback.

title: Epic
description: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it.
